cells.albedo: a solar reflectance factor that relates the amount of diffuse radiation to global irradiation (0.15) | The albedo effect also indicates a low diffuse-to-global ratio, which is consistent with high cloud cover or pollution (Section III.B).
cells.algorithm: The PVLib library includes several algorithms for calculating solar irradiance, and these can be combined in various ways to suit specific needs (Section III.J).
cells.architecture: The Python-based PVlib was chosen due to its flexibility and open-source nature with a clean architecture using core and package objects (Section II).
cells.capacity: The capacity is reduced after a damage event, with some PV systems experiencing a reduction in capacity by up to 4.3%.
cells.cell: A cell has a fill_factor greater than 0.95 indicating that up to more than one electron is captured for each photon absorbed by the material (Section III.G).
cells.climate_zone: the climate zone determines the type of insulation and cooling requirements in a PV system.
cells.closed-circuit: electricity is generated using the PV system in a closed circuit.
cells.comparison: a comparison of the PV performance under various conditions is made to evaluate the effectiveness of the different configurations.
cells.condition: PV system can operate in any environmental condition, including temperatures below 20°C at which they would normally not perform efficiently (Section I).
cells.damage: damages in the PV system include crack in panel, hot spots and micro-cracks.
cells.data: Data on various input/output parameters can be stored in a database to evaluate performance (Section III.J). | input parameter values for the evaluation can then be changed and run using either Python or MATLAB.
cells.design: The efficiency of a PV system is influenced by its design, including factors such as location and number of panels (Section III.G).
cells.diode: the ideal diode model describes the behavior of an ideal current source in series with an ideal diode.
cells.heterojunction: Heterojunction is a type of bipolar junction in a diode.
